description: Ready-to-use plates, tubes, and dehydrated media from Liofilchem for microbial isolation and identification. The range includes chromogenic and selective media that help labs differentiate target organisms directly on the plate, reducing follow-up testing.

Liofilchem's antibiotic discs and MIC test strips for resistance profiling by disc diffusion or minimum inhibitory concentration. Products cover a wide range of organism-antimicrobial combinations and work with current EUCAST and CLSI interpretive criteria.

Sacace's real-time PCR kits for hepatitis B/C, HIV, HPV genotyping, respiratory panels, and STI detection. Both qualitative and quantitative formats available, compatible with common real-time PCR platforms.

ViennaLab's reverse-hybridization strip tests for pharmacogenetics (CYP2D6, CYP2C19), thrombophilia (Factor V Leiden, Prothrombin), and HLA-B27. A cost-effective way to run targeted genotyping without sequencing infrastructure.

Bacteriophage-based biocontrol from Micreos. PhageGuard Listex and PhageGuard S use naturally occurring phages to reduce Listeria and Salmonella on food surfaces. No chemicals, no antibiotics, no impact on taste or texture.

Antibodies, antigens, and enzymes from Medix Biochemica for IVD assay development and manufacturing. Used by kit makers building cardiac, infectious disease, and hormone assays who need consistent lot-to-lot performance at production scale.

Candor Bioscience's LowCross-Buffer, Assay Defender, and HAMA blockers for ELISA and lateral flow development. If you're fighting background noise, heterophilic interference, or reagent degradation, these are purpose-built solutions from a team that specializes in assay troubleshooting.
